title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
clause_1_scope: 3 TERMINOLOGY This Standard covers the requirements for aggregates, crushed or uncrushed, derived from natural sources, such as river terraces and riverbeds, glacial deposits, rocks, boulders and gravels, and manufactured aggregates produced from other than natural sources, for use in the production of concrete for normal structural purposes including mass concrete works.
